item.title: GNOME 开发环境
item.description: Debugging across GLib 和 GTK 需要 a consistent 依赖 graph. If GTK loads a 开发 libgtk but resolves GLib, Pango, 或 GDK Pixbuf 来自 the host, 源码 lines 和 runtime types no longer correspond 到 one coherent build. 一个 isolated installation prefix 提供 consistency without replacing distribution packages.
